description: Highway Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) is a dataset listed in US Department of Transportation open data portal (datahub.transportation.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a national body, published or maintained by US Department of Transportation. The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) has been receiving Highway inventory, usage, condition and performance data from State Departments of Transportation (DOT) since 1978 to support the program mission of the FHWA. Specifically, HPMS consists of detailed road segment data (63 Attributes) for higher order systems. Coverage: United States. The portal files it under the category Roadways and Bridges. Its tags are arnold, hpms. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Federal Highway Administration. The portal shows 2021-04-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-transportation-gov-portal.
